summary.en: BenchCouncil AI100 (2022-2023) annual entry in Vision

description.en:
BenchCouncil lists Multiresolution hash encoding in the Vision area of its AI100 (2022-2023) annual table. It associates the work with the publication “Instant Neural Graphics Primitives with a Multiresolution Hash Encoding”. The page names Thomas Muller, Alexander Keller as the main contributors.

This Archive record preserves the official row order, citation value, institution, and country fields. It represents the annual 2022-2023 selection and remains separate from the long-term canonical AI100 storyline.
